title: eludite.file.read input
description: Read a text file with line numbers: from its open document when it is open (unsaved text included), else from disk. At most 2,000 lines or 256 KB per call; a longer read answers `truncated` with the line to ask for next. A binary file is refused with its size. A relative path is resolved against the workspace folder and may not leave it; an absolute path outside the workspace is read when it is readable (the call is audited either way).

path.description: Absolute path, or a path relative to the workspace folder.

startLine.description: 1-based first line to read; 1 when omitted.

endLine.description: 1-based last line to read (inclusive); the end of the file, or the cap, when omitted.
